list.label: Aasimar
list.desc: Blessed with a celestial heritage, Aasimar radiate inner light and wield divine power to heal allies and smite enemies with radiant energy.

list.label: Dragonborn
list.desc: Born of draconic lineage, Dragonborn command elemental breath weapons and draconic wings, embodying the might of ancient dragons.

list.label: Dwarf
list.desc: Hardy and resilient folk forged by centuries in mountain halls, Dwarves resist poison and channel tremorsense through the stone beneath their feet.

list.label: Elf
list.desc: Graceful and long-lived, Elves enter a meditative trance instead of sleeping and inherit unique magical gifts from their chosen lineage.

list.label: Gnome
list.desc: Curious and inventive, Gnomes have an innate cleverness that grants them advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

list.label: Goliath
list.desc: Descendants of giants, Goliaths stand above other races in size and strength, able to grow Large and draw power from their giant ancestry.

list.label: Halfling
list.desc: Lucky and nimble, Halflings never suffer critical failures — when they roll a 1 on any d20 Test they can reroll and must use the new roll.

list.label: Human
list.desc: The most adaptable of all races, Humans gain an extra Origin feat at character creation, an extra skill proficiency, and Heroic Inspiration every Long Rest.

list.label: Orc
list.desc: Powerful and fierce, Orcs can Dash as a Bonus Action to gain Temporary Hit Points, and once per Long Rest refuse to fall below 1 Hit Point.

list.label: Tiefling
list.desc: Touched by infernal bloodlines, Tieflings choose a fiendish legacy that grants unique spells and resistance to Fire damage.

list.label: Barbarian
list.desc: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage

list.label: Bard
list.desc: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation

list.label: Cleric
list.desc: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power

list.label: Druid
list.desc: A mage wielding the powers of nature — moonlight and plant growth, fire and lightning — and adopting animal forms

list.label: Fighter
list.desc: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor

list.label: Monk
list.desc: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection

list.label: Paladin
list.desc: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath, harnessing power of divine

list.label: Ranger
list.desc: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization

list.label: Rogue
list.desc: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies

list.label: Sorcerer
list.desc: A spell-caster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline

list.label: Warlock
list.desc: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an extra-planar entity

list.label: Wizard
list.desc: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality

spellClasses.label: Bard

spellClasses.label: Cleric
spellClasses.desc: Divine magic channelled from the power of the gods and sacred domains

spellClasses.label: Druid
spellClasses.desc: Nature magic wielding moonlight, plant growth, fire and lightning

spellClasses.label: Paladin
spellClasses.desc: Sacred oaths and divine smites empowered by holy conviction

spellClasses.label: Ranger
spellClasses.desc: Nature spells and primal magic to combat threats at civilisation's edge

spellClasses.label: Sorcerer
spellClasses.desc: Raw arcane power drawn from an innate magical gift or bloodline

spellClasses.label: Warlock
spellClasses.desc: Eldritch magic derived from a pact with an extra-planar entity

spellClasses.label: Wizard
spellClasses.desc: Scholarly arcane magic capable of manipulating the structures of reality
